Getting Full Dentures

A 1-minute patient guide with narration. Press space to pause, F for full screen.

Patient guide

Full dentures.

A complete smile, made just for you.

A whole new smile.

When all the teeth in an arch are missing, a full denture replaces them.

Why it matters.

Without teeth, chewing is harder, speech can change, and your face loses support.

Made to fit you.

We take careful impressions and measurements of your gums and your bite.

Try it in.

A test version lets us check the look, the fit, and your bite before the final denture is made.

Your new denture.

Natural-looking teeth on a gum-colored base, shaped to rest snugly on your gums.

Getting used to it.

It may feel bulky at first. Most people adjust within a few weeks.

Start with soft foodsCut food into small piecesPractice speaking

Daily care.

A few simple habits keep your denture clean and comfortable.

Rinse after mealsBrush it dailySoak it overnightKeep your checkups

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step.
